title: Gleaming Dance

outfit_card.silhouette: Strapless ball gown with a fitted, draped satin bodice and a voluminous tiered tulle skirt; a cascading back bustle and asymmetrical sheer tulle overskirt create a romantic, airy A-line silhouette.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A slender, feather-like white hairpin with delicate silver filigree and small pearl accents, placed asymmetrically to catch the light.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A strapless bodice of lustrous lavender satin, ruched and gathered with an ornate brooch of white feathers and pearl clusters at the center, paired with elbow-length pale lilac gloves.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A full, layered skirt with a crisp white tulle base, overlaid with sheer lilac tulle and scattered pearl sprays and floral appliqué; a draped satin bustle falls to the back.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A luminous pearl-and-feather brooch, delicate trailing vine motifs, and subtle floating star-like sparkles that accompany the dance.
